segments.name: Cross-border e-commerce
segments.description: Provides merchants with a localized platform to sell internationally, handling pricing, payments, duties, shipping, returns and after-sales support for global shoppers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Merchants pay for the company's platform services that localize their online stores and handle pricing, payments, duties, shipping and returns for international shoppers.
revenueModel.evidence: We integrate with and enhance the online stores of merchants and localize the shoppers' experience based on the country from which they shop.
